The '''Gray Fox''' was a model of truncated [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by the [[Meirm Speeder Emporium]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Meirm Gray Fox was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 3.2: Rise of the Emperor, in which it is purchasable from the Security Key Vendor by players who have a security key.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''
